```js
await (async (page) => {
  const dictionary={book:'libro',house:'casa',cat:'gato',dog:'perro',mom:'mamá',dad:'papá',milk:'leche',water:'agua',boy:'niño',girl:'niña',bread:'pan',apple:'manzana',coffee:'café',tea:'té',man:'hombre',woman:'mujer'};
  const events=[];
  const deadline=Date.now()+90000;
  for(let attempt=0;attempt<25 && Date.now()<deadline;attempt++){
    await page.getByRole('button',{name:/^(Check|Continue)$/}).last().waitFor();
    const before=await page.locator('body').ariaSnapshot();
    const choice=page.getByRole('radio').filter({visible:true});
    const enabled=[];
    for(const item of await choice.all()) if(await item.isEnabled()) enabled.push(item);
    if(enabled.length){
      const heading=await page.getByRole('heading',{level:1}).last().innerText();
      let word=heading.match(/“([^”]+)”/)?.[1];
      if(!word && heading==='Select the correct meaning'){
        events.push({before,status:'paused',reason:'Need fresh model inspection of unlabelled prompt'});break;
      }
      const answer=dictionary[word];
      if(!answer){events.push({before,status:'paused',reason:'Unknown prompt'});break;}
      let selected=null;
      for(const item of enabled){
        const text=(await item.innerText()).replace(/ [0-9] /g,'').trim();
        if(text===answer){selected=item;break;}
      }
      if(!selected){events.push({before,status:'paused',reason:'No semantic option match'});break;}
      await selected.click();
      await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Check',exact:true}).click();
      const feedback=await page.locator('body').ariaSnapshot();
      events.push({before,action:{selectMeaning:word,selectLabel:answer,submit:true},feedback,time:new Date().toISOString()});
      await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Continue',exact:true}).click();
    } else if(await page.getByRole('heading',{name:'Select the matching pairs',exact:true}).count()){
      events.push({before,status:'paused',reason:'Matching needs explicit pairs'});break;
    } else if(await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Continue',exact:true}).isVisible()){
      events.push({before,action:'continue',time:new Date().toISOString()});
      await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Continue',exact:true}).click();
    } else {events.push({before,status:'paused',reason:'Unknown screen'});break;}
  }
  return events;
})(page);
```
